meta.title: Conversation Folders Archive
meta.description: One dedicated folder per conversation, named after the conversation title: the transcript is archived automatically; the optional output directory is not prompted automatically by default — open the system folder picker from the sidebar “会话文件夹” panel button or the API when needed (set autoPromptOutputDir: true to restore the automatic prompt at conversation start), and after each organize the produced files (调研<N>_original) are copied to <output dir>/<session folder name>/ for easy extraction; tables/charts and other files are auto-categorized and renamed only after the conversation has been idle for a while, so files stay in place and viewable while it is active; after archiving, entry points at the original paths are kept (hard link / directory junction), so old file links in the conversation still open directly; deleting a conversation permanently removes all of its files, including the output-dir copies.
